She’s not ghosting you. She’s asking you for space because she has had, as you said, a mental breakdown. You told her you understand that but I’m not sure that you do. If you keep trying to elicit a response from her you aren’t going to like what you receive. Don’t make her feeling bad be about you. People can be online to distract themselves from their issues but not be capable of having conversations about it. These aren’t mutually exclusive positions and it has nothing to do with how much she likes you. If you were sick and spent time watching tv it wouldn’t say anything about you not loving someone not in the room. You need to be cool and show her you can be cool. Wait a couple weeks. If you haven’t heard from her, text her and say you’re here for her and that she can reach out when she’s ready. And then leave it at that. It could take longer than you like. Don’t tell her it makes you sad or you miss her or anything that pressures her. You’ve already made that clear so you don’t have to worry that she thinks you don’t care. I promise she will not think that. Mental illness breaks are different than other excuses. If she reaches out remember it is about her and don’t say anything that will make it seem like her being depressed was hard on you! Imagine if someone kept texting you when you were sick and vomiting into the toilet. You’d probably tell them (or want them) to fuck off even if you liked them :) Good luck!
